🪕💃🏽 Learn to contra dance at Harvest Fest! 🕺🎻 

Contra dance may be new to MHF, but it’s not new to Colorado’s Western Slope! This tradition dates back to the early anglo-settlers who arrived in the valley around the turn of the century. Contra dance has been a popular pastime and place for community connection ever since. 

📆 Saturday, September 26th
⏰ 3 pm
📍 Paonia Town Park

Contra is a partner-style dance where dancers form long, parallel lines, and dance in groups of four with interchanging couples. A ‘”caller” instructs the steps while a live band plays up-beat traditional folk music. 

📣 No experience needed!
📣 A caller will tell you exactly what to do!
📣 Bring a partner or meet one there!

We can’t wait to welcome hardpressedband and caller Andrea Earley Coen to the stage to keep this tradition alive and thriving at Mountain Harvest Fest! 🎶⛰️🌶️
